## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm test`, and `npm run build` all pass
- [ ] No real financial data in the diff, the screenshots, or the description — amounts, merchant names, account numbers, and phone numbers redacted
- [ ] Nothing under `data/` is staged
- [ ] If this adds a network call, it's documented in the README's **Privacy** section
- [ ] If this adds a dependency, the README says why a few lines wouldn't do
